name: com.katout.flowtask.unitask
description: Bridges Cysharp UniTask and FlowTask in both directions: FromUniTask / AsFlow with scope cancellation through a CancellationToken, ToUniTask for a running flow. Needs com.cysharp.unitask in the project (install it yourself: git URL or OpenUPM); without it the FlowTask.UniTask assembly is not compiled. UniTask imported as a .unitypackage is not a UPM package: add FLOWTASK_UNITASK to Scripting Define Symbols.
